about.bio: Ray Calder grew up tending his grandfather's cinder-block pit outside Amarillo before hauling the family rub book north to the Treasure Valley. He welded the offset smoker himself, splits his own oak, and still refuses to bolt on a gas assist. One truck, one fire, one rule: if it wouldn't pass at the family table, it doesn't go out the window.

schedule.note: Smoker's resting. Prepping meat for the week.
Church, family, football. See you Tuesday.
